title: Key dates if you use Chroma Cloud: read-only from 22 Nov, reads stop 22 Dec, so export before then. Self-hosted ChromaDB is unaffected and stays Apache 2.0. Anyone still on Chroma Cloud? Where are you moving?

content_html:
Chroma, the AI database millions of developers learned on, is joining Replit and shutting its cloud in 60 days

From madrobot.blog•Yesterday•4m read time

Chroma, maker of the open-source vector database ChromaDB, is joining Replit, the AI app-building platform. Chroma Cloud, its paid hosted service, becomes read-only on November 22, 2026 and stops serving reads on December 22, 2026. Open-source ChromaDB continues under the Apache 2.0 license, and Chroma has moved more code from private repos into the public project. Chroma CEO Jeff Huber says open-source Chroma gets about 6 million downloads a month and has nearly 30,000 GitHub stars. Replit's CEO and early investors in Chroma, and Masad was named as an angel in its $18 million 2023 seed round.
